meaning.en: a large boat used for sailing or racing, often for pleasure

sentences.en: A white yacht sails on the sea.
sentences.zh: 一艘白色游艇在海上航行。

sentences.en: The growing popularity of yacht tourism can generate income for coastal communities but may damage marine habitats.
sentences.zh: 游艇旅游日益流行，能为沿海社区创造收入，但也可能破坏海洋栖息地。

meaning.en: an area of open ground around or next to a house

sentences.en: The dog runs in the yard.
sentences.zh: 那只狗在院子里跑。

sentences.en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
sentences.zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

meaning.en: Thread used for knitting or weaving cloth.

sentences.en: She chose soft blue yarn for the baby's blanket.
sentences.zh: 她挑了柔软的蓝色毛线来织婴儿毯。

sentences.en: Using yarn made from recycled materials can reduce waste in the textile industry.
sentences.zh: 使用再生材料制成的纱线可以减少纺织业的废弃物。

meaning.en: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply, usually because you are tired or bored

sentences.en: I yawn when I feel tired.
sentences.zh: 我累的时候会打哈欠。

sentences.en: Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 经常在早课上打哈欠的学生，可能夜间睡眠不足。

meaning.zh: 是的；对（非正式，表示同意或肯定）
meaning.en: used informally to say yes or to show agreement

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd love to come to the party.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很想来参加聚会。

sentences.en: “Are you ready?” “Yeah, just give me a second.”
sentences.zh: “你准备好了吗？”“是的，稍等我一下。”

meaning.en: a period of twelve months, especially from January to December

sentences.en: I am eight years old this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年八岁。

sentences.en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
sentences.zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

meaning.en: happening once every year

sentences.en: The company holds a yearly meeting in December.
sentences.zh: 公司每年十二月举行一次年度会议。

sentences.en: The yearly report summarizes the company's performance over the past year.
sentences.zh: 年度报告总结了过去一年公司的业绩。

meaning.en: once a year

sentences.en: The festival is held yearly in this town.
sentences.zh: 这个节日每年都在这个镇上举行。

sentences.en: The data is updated yearly to reflect the latest trends.
sentences.zh: 数据每年更新一次，以反映最新趋势。

meaning.en: to want something very much

sentences.en: I yearn for a quiet holiday.
sentences.zh: 我渴望一个安静的假期。

sentences.en: Many urban residents yearn for quieter surroundings, which may explain the growing appeal of rural tourism.
sentences.zh: 许多城市居民渴望更安静的环境，这或许能解释乡村旅游日益增长的吸引力。

meaning.en: A fungus used to make bread rise and produce alcohol.

sentences.en: Add the yeast once the water feels slightly warm.
sentences.zh: 等水摸起来微温时加入酵母。

sentences.en: Scientists use yeast to study basic cellular processes because it grows quickly under controlled laboratory conditions.
sentences.zh: 科学家利用酵母研究基本细胞过程，因为它在受控实验室条件下生长迅速。

meaning.en: to shout in a loud voice

sentences.en: Do not yell in the quiet hall.
sentences.zh: 不要在安静的礼堂里大喊大叫。

sentences.en: Coaches who yell at young athletes may undermine their confidence rather than improve their performance.
sentences.zh: 对年轻运动员大吼大叫的教练可能会打击他们的信心，而不是提高他们的表现。

meaning.en: having the colour of a lemon or gold

sentences.en: She chose a yellow umbrella for her walk in the rain.
sentences.zh: 她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。

sentences.en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
sentences.zh: 黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。

meaning.en: the colour of a lemon or gold

sentences.en: Yellow is her favourite colour.
sentences.zh: 黄色是她最喜欢的颜色。

meaning.en: used to give an affirmative answer or express agreement

sentences.en: Yes, I can help you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我可以帮你。

sentences.en: She said yes when I asked if she would join us.
sentences.zh: 我问她是否愿意加入我们时，她答应了。

meaning.en: an affirmative answer or vote

sentences.en: There were ten yeses and two noes.
sentences.zh: 有十票赞成，两票反对。

meaning.en: the day before today

sentences.en: I played football with Tom yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天和汤姆一起踢足球了。

sentences.en: The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.
sentences.zh: 昨天发布的交通调查表明，在市中心通勤的人越来越倾向于骑车而非开车。

meaning.zh: 尚未；还（用于否定句和疑问句）
meaning.en: until now; still not (used in negative sentences and questions)

sentences.en: The school bus has not come yet.
sentences.zh: 校车还没来。

sentences.en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

meaning.zh: 出产；产生（作物、结果或利润）
meaning.en: to produce a crop, result, or profit

sentences.en: These fields yield wheat every summer.
sentences.zh: 这些田地每年夏天都出产小麦。

sentences.en: Investment in agricultural research can yield substantial benefits for food security without expanding farmland.
sentences.zh: 对农业研究的投资可以在不扩大耕地的情况下，为粮食安全带来显著益处。

meaning.zh: （方言或罕用）瑜伽；也指一种印度教修行方式
meaning.en: a rare or dialectal variant of yoga; also refers to a Hindu spiritual practice

sentences.en: In some old texts, the word yog is used to refer to yoga.
sentences.zh: 在一些古老文本中，yog 一词被用来指瑜伽。

sentences.en: The practice of yog, though uncommon in modern English, still appears in regional writings.
sentences.zh: yog 这种修行方式在现代英语中虽不常见，但仍出现在地方性作品中。

meaning.en: a system of exercises for the body and mind, often involving stretching and breathing control

sentences.en: Mum does yoga in the morning.
sentences.zh: 妈妈早上练瑜伽。

sentences.en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
sentences.zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。

meaning.en: a thick, slightly sour food made from milk by adding bacteria

sentences.en: I eat yoghurt with fruit.
sentences.zh: 我吃酸奶配水果。

sentences.en: She bought a large tub of plain yoghurt at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 她在超市买了一大桶原味酸奶。

meaning.en: a thick, slightly sour food made from milk fermented with bacteria

sentences.en: I eat yogurt with fruit.
sentences.zh: 我吃酸奶配水果。

sentences.en: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
sentences.zh: 原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。

meaning.en: a wooden bar used to join two animals together, or a symbol of control and burden

sentences.en: Oxen pulled the cart under a yoke.
sentences.zh: 牛在轭下拉着车。

sentences.en: Many communities struggled for generations to free themselves from the yoke of colonial rule.
sentences.zh: 许多群体为摆脱殖民统治的枷锁，进行了数代人的抗争。

meaning.en: the yellow part of an egg

sentences.en: The yolk is rich and yellow.
sentences.zh: 蛋黄营养丰富，呈黄色。

sentences.en: Separate the yolk from the white before beating the eggs.
sentences.zh: 打蛋前先把蛋黄和蛋清分开。

meaning.en: the person or people being spoken to

sentences.en: You are my best friend.
sentences.zh: 你是我最好的朋友。

sentences.en: If you want to improve your English, you should practice every day.
sentences.zh: 如果你想提高英语，你应该每天练习。

meaning.en: not old; in the early years of life

sentences.en: The young cat plays with yarn.
sentences.zh: 这只小猫在玩毛线。

sentences.en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
sentences.zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。

meaning.en: A child or young person.

sentences.en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
sentences.zh: 一个开朗的孩子帮我捡起了那些苹果。

sentences.en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
sentences.zh: 社区体育项目让青少年有机会培养团队协作能力，并在校外建立友谊。

meaning.en: belonging to or connected with the person or people you are speaking to

sentences.en: Please put your shoes by the door.
sentences.zh: 请把你的鞋放在门边。

sentences.en: Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
sentences.zh: 选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。

meaning.en: the one or ones belonging to you

sentences.en: Is this pen yours?
sentences.zh: 这支笔是你的吗？

sentences.en: My answer was different from yours.
sentences.zh: 我的答案和你的不一样。

meaning.zh: 你自己（反身代词，用于第二人称单数）
meaning.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the subject is 'you' (singular), referring back to the same person

sentences.en: Be careful with that knife, or you might cut yourself.
sentences.zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。

sentences.en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
sentences.zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。

meaning.zh: 你们自己（用作宾语或强调）
meaning.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the subject is 'you' (plural), or for emphasis

sentences.en: Please help yourselves.

meaning.en: the period of life before you become an adult

sentences.en: He played football in his youth.
sentences.zh: 他年轻时踢过足球。

sentences.en: Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
sentences.zh: 对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。

meaning.en: Looking young or showing the energy and qualities of youth.

sentences.en: My grandfather still has a youthful smile and boundless energy.
sentences.zh: 我祖父依然有着年轻的笑容和充沛的精力。

sentences.en: A youthful workforce can bring fresh ideas, while experienced employees contribute valuable practical knowledge.
sentences.zh: 年轻的员工队伍能带来新想法，而经验丰富的员工则贡献宝贵的实践经验。

meaning.zh: 令人恶心的；令人不快的
meaning.en: disgusting or very unpleasant

sentences.en: This old cheese tastes yucky.
sentences.zh: 这块旧奶酪尝起来很恶心。

sentences.en: The medicine left a yucky taste in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 这药在我嘴里留下了一股恶心的味道。

meaning.en: tasting very good; delicious

sentences.en: The cake is yummy and sweet.
sentences.zh: 这个蛋糕又美味又甜。

sentences.en: She made a yummy soup with fresh vegetables.
sentences.zh: 她用新鲜蔬菜做了一锅美味的汤。
